recipe.label: Macro Microscopy

traits.texture: translucent cell-like chambers, fine membranes, delicate veins and shallow optical depth
traits.composition: choose one identifiable natural detail from the reference and enlarge it into a carefully framed detail study
traits.lighting: soft transmitted light with crisp selected membranes and gradual focus falloff

review_checks: A botanical detail from the source is identifiable
Fine membranes and translucent layers establish the macro treatment
The result is documented as a detail study rather than a preserved wide scene
limitations: Cell-like structures are imagined; the image cannot identify species, demonstrate biological anatomy or substitute for microscopy.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style example; intended use: One Macro Microscopy example for the Optical and Material Styles collection
Primary request: A steep lush hillside garden, a thick tree trunk framing the left, three tall narrow conifers near the center and right, sloping grass, a winding pale path, layered shrubs, a small blue roof and distant hills under a bright sky.
Style/medium: microscopy-inspired botanical macro illustration
Color palette: #F8F6E9, #C6D7B5, #7A9D83, #285D68
Materials/textures: translucent cell-like chambers, fine membranes, delicate veins and shallow optical depth
Composition/framing: choose one identifiable natural detail from the reference and enlarge it into a carefully framed detail study; Make an intentional close detail study of one green leaf from the left foreground foliage. Keep its tapering shape and branching veins; enlarge it to fill the landscape frame with pale translucent cellular compartments. The hillside can appear only as distant green bokeh. This recipe intentionally changes framing; do not pretend to preserve the whole garden.
Lighting/mood: soft transmitted light with crisp selected membranes and gradual focus falloff
Requested output target: 1536x1024, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: copied reference collages; presenter portraits; logos and brand marks; unrequested lettering; unrelated objects
Constraints: Make an intentional close detail study of one green leaf from the left foreground foliage. Keep its tapering shape and branching veins; enlarge it to fill the landscape frame with pale translucent cellular compartments. The hillside can appear only as distant green bokeh. This recipe intentionally changes framing; do not pretend to preserve the whole garden.; Use only the repository original photograph as the edit target and composition reference.
